title: AQUARELLE WATERCOLOR: PROCREATE BRUSHES
author: Leonard Posavec
description:
INTRODUCING Aquarelle Watercolor: Procreate Brushes, an aquarelle watercolor brush set for Procreate featuring 16 realistic texture brushes, perfect for illustrations for kids, watercolor-style illustrations, Japan style, and realistic projects, and pressure-sensitive brushes perfect for hand lettering! Also, it includes 5 paper textures ideal for aquarelle/watercolor drawing!
In this set, you will get 16 realistic aquarelle watercolor-inspired brushes and paper textures for creative projects. You will love to use these brushes in Procreate on any kind of project, from illustrations for kids, watercolor-style illustrations, and comic and realistic projects. Also, there are included brushes for watercolor style lettering
To use the brushes simply choose a brush, select the paint tool and draw. The color and width of the strokes can be adjusted easily.
IMPORTANT:
These brushes are ONLY for Procreate and for use with Apple Pencil or compatible stylus. These brushes DO NOT WORK IN PHOTOSHOP or ILLUSTRATOR.
WHAT IS INCLUDED: *Brushes: Aquarelle_Watercolor_Procreate_Brushes *Textures: PaperTexture1.jpg, PaperTexture2.jpg, PaperTexture3.jpg, PaperTexture4.jpg, PaperTexture5.jpg
HOW TO INSTALL: Download the .zip file. Go to the .zip file, preview the content, you will see the brushes file, click on it and it will be imported to Procreate on your iPad.
